marketing_steps.description: Present AION C IDE and the Software Developer Package on the morning of 6 June 1978.

marketing_presentation.description: Introduce the platform interfaces that the Software Developer Package exposes: FlexiBUS, display interfaces, implementation and licensing, compatibility and third-party peripheral development.
